```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
claim_fill <- "#374151"
context_fill <- "#9CA3AF"
# 2021 was cancelled, and its records are campus pro-day workouts (pro-day-year).
pro_day_year <- 2021L
combine <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "combine") |>
  mutate(
    position_group = factor(combine_position_group(pos), pos_levels),
    drafted = !is.na(draft_round)
  )
combine_span <- paste0(
  min(combine$season),
  " to ",
  max(combine$season),
  " combines"
)
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
# One position per player-season (a handful of ids repeat within a season).
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position
   FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
# Draft-eligible player-seasons with the invitation flag, by draft year.
funnel <- build_combine_funnel(combine, outcomes) |>
  left_join(roster_pos, by = c("playerId", "season"), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group(position), c(pos_levels, "Position not recorded")))
by_year <- funnel |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible = n(),
    invited_n = sum(invited),
    invite_rate = mean(invited),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
invite_hi_year <- by_year$draft_year[which.max(by_year$invite_rate)]
by_pos_year <- funnel |>
  filter(position_group %in% pos_levels) |>
  group_by(position_group, draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible = n(),
    invited_n = sum(invited),
    invite_rate = mean(invited),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- by_year |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %d of %d eligible seasons invited (%.1f%%)",
      draft_year,
      invited_n,
      eligible,
      100 * invite_rate
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(draft_year, 100 * invite_rate, fill = draft_year == invite_hi_year)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = pro_day_year - 0.5,
    xmax = pro_day_year + 0.5,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = draft_year), width = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#111827") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(by_year$draft_year),
    y = 10.4,
    label = "One in ten",
    hjust = 1,
    colour = "#111827",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = context_fill, `TRUE` = claim_fill), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
    breaks = seq(0, 12, 2),
    limits = c(0, 12)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(by_year$draft_year), max(by_year$draft_year), 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "What share of draft-eligible players does the combine invite each year?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Invitees among draft-eligible seasons, ",
      combine_span,
      "; highest year in dark grey"
    ),
    x = "Draft year (shaded 2021: pro-day data)",
    y = "Share invited",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "combine-invitation-rate", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-position
p_pos <- by_pos_year |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s: %d of %d eligible seasons invited (%.1f%%)",
      position_group,
      draft_year,
      invited_n,
      eligible,
      100 * invite_rate
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(draft_year, invite_rate, colour = position_group, group = position_group)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = pro_day_year - 0.5,
    xmax = pro_day_year + 0.5,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, draft_year)), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_position() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(by_year$draft_year), max(by_year$draft_year), 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Which position groups see the highest invitation rates?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "One line per position group, by the roster position in the eligible season, ",
      combine_span
    ),
    x = "Draft year (shaded 2021: pro-day data)",
    y = "Share invited",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_pos, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```
